title: Resident Accounts Standard: Occupancy, Administrative Retention and Monthly Amortization of the Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
Resident Accounts standard for the refundable balance of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** from occupancy onward.

**1. Occupancy.** Occupancy may be recorded only after the full entrance fee is received, the entrance fee received (every deposit payment and balance payment on the agreement) being equal to the entrance fee of the agreement.

**2. Administrative retention.** On the occupancy date the plan's administrative percentage of the entrance fee, rounded to the cent half up, becomes non-refundable as one administrative retention dated the occupancy date.

**3. Monthly amortization.** Thereafter one amortization is booked for each month of occupancy, the first for the month beginning on the occupancy date and each later one on the monthly anniversary of the occupancy date.

> Retired clause, no longer in force: the clause that each amortization is of the plan's monthly amortization percentage of the entrance fee rounded to the cent half up. It is superseded by the current basis for the amount of each month's amortization.

**4. Floor and end.** Amortization stops once the refundable balance reaches the plan's refundable floor percentage of the entrance fee, the final month amortizing only the amount down to the floor, and stops at the termination date.

> Retired clause, no longer in force: "a month that starts on or before the termination date is amortized in full". It is superseded by the current basis for the share of the final month amortized.

**5. Status and once-only booking.**

> Retired clause, no longer in force: "Amortization may be booked only while the agreement is in occupied status, and each month of occupancy is amortized once." It is superseded by the current basis for when amortization is booked.

**6. Move to care.** A move to Larkspur assisted living or memory care on the campus does not stop amortization, because where the plan keeps the agreement in force on such a move the agreement remains occupied.

**7. Months of occupancy.** Months of occupancy run from the occupancy date to the termination date (or to the handling date while occupied); each month beginning on the occupancy date or on a monthly anniversary of it on or before the end date counts in full, a month started counting as a whole month.

## Months of occupancy (hypothetical occupancy on 10 March)

| End date | Months beginning on or before the end date | Months of occupancy |
|---|---|---|
| 9 April | 10 March | 1 |
| 10 April | 10 March, 10 April | 2 |
| 25 June | 10 March, 10 April, 10 May, 10 June | 4 |

## Occupancy recording check

| Entrance fee received compared with the entrance fee | Occupancy may be recorded |
|---|---|
| Equal | Yes |
| Less | No |
